text:
Tessa: Heads-up — a walk-in guest (Marta from Acme) is at the lobby with two suitcases, a stroller, and a toddler. She didn't pre-register, says meeting is in 20 minutes. Can we badge her for a short visit?
front-desk: Hi — we can do a temp guest badge until 3pm. Need a quick name + company and whether they want access to meeting rooms. Also FYI: a perishable sample box just arrived labelled 'keep refrigerated'.
Tessa: Thanks. Name=Marta, company=Acme. She only needs to be buzzed into Meeting Room A for ~30m. Toddler is with her, so stroller storage would help.
Rami: We have a stroller hook near the racks — front-desk can they leave it there? Also happy to grab the sample box and put it in the fridge.
front-desk: Stroller hook OK. We can issue a badge color yellow (visitor-temp). If anyone is leaving items overnight we need manager signoff — per building rules.
Jorge: I'll swing by and help ferry the stroller to the coat area.
Alex: Meeting Room A is free for the next hour, I'll toss a quick invite so they don't get lost. :white_check_mark:
Tessa: Awesome. About the perishable — vendor marked it as cake samples for product team. Who can put it in the fridge and label it?
Lisa: I can do it. Be there in 5. Please label with team and "samples" so it's obvious.
front-desk: Quick log for records:
```
checkin: name=Marta company=Acme badge=temp-yellow-3246001111 access=MeetingRoomA expires=15:00 notes="stroller, toddler, sample-box"
```
Tessa: Thanks all. Marta looks relieved. Lisa — much appreciated.
Alex: Also — do we want to offer a highchair or quiet corner? We have a small bench near MR-A that usually works.
Rami: I'll set the bench with a small blanket. Kid-friendly vibes. :smile:
Jorge: Who wants cupcakes if the samples are good? :raising_hand:
front-desk: Please remember to remove perishable items by end of day unless manager approves overnight storage.
Tessa: Noted. Closing the loop — badge issued, stroller stored, fridge taken care of. Thanks team! :tada:
